armies_of_renown.name: The First Phalanx of Ionrach
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Idoneth Deepkin faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the First Phalanx of Ionrach Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules in this section instead of the Idoneth Deepkin faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the FIRST PHALANX keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Volturnos, High King of the Deep (must be included and must be your general)
Any AKHELIAN units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

entries.unit: Volturnos, High King of the Deep

battle_traits.name: The Shield of Ulchiss
battle_traits.declare: You must spend 1 asydrazor point each time a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• That unit can use a RETREAT ability and still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later in the turn.
• No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by RETREAT abilities.

battle_traits.name: The Spear of Asphoren
battle_traits.declare: You must spend 1 asydrazor point each time a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: The Sword of Gwynnar
battle_traits.declare: You must spend 1 asydrazor point each time a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: That unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Prodigy of the Asydrazor
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared an ASYDRAZOR ability for a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
entries.effect: No asydrazor points are spent to use that ability.

entries.name: Voidchill Darkness
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit if this unit charged this turn.

entries.name: Deep Connection
entries.effect: Ignore the effect of the Companion weapon ability on this unit's weapons.

entries.name: Swift-finned Skirmisher
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for this unit
entries.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that this unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

armies_of_renown.name: Wardens of the Chorrileum
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Idoneth Deepkin faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Wardens of the Chorrileum Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules in this section instead of the Idoneth Deepkin faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the CHORRILEUM keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Sea or Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Storm (1 of these units must be included. No more than 1 can be included.)
Any ISHARANN units
Any NAMARTI units
Any AKHELIAN INFANTRY units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: The Ocean Conceals
battle_traits.declare: This ability must be used to deploy the friendly CHORRILEUM EIDOLON instead of the 'Deploy Unit' ability or the 'Deploy Regiment' ability.
battle_traits.effect: Set up the friendly CHORRILEUM EIDOLON in reserve awaiting a summons. It has now been deployed.

battle_traits.name: Spirits of the Chorrileum
battle_traits.effect:
Each turn, you can gain up to 1 chorrileum spirit point. You gain 1 chorrileum spirit point the first time 1 of the following occurs in a turn:
• You make an unmodified casting roll of 8 or more for a friendly ISHARANN WIZARD.
• An enemy unit is destroyed while it is within 12" of any friendly ISHARANN units.
• A friendly unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly ISHARANN units or while it is contesting an objective you control.

battle_traits.name: Call Forth the Tsunami
battle_traits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have 3 or more chorrileum spirit points. Pick a friendly unit awaiting a summons to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with it.

battle_traits.name: Wrath of Mathlann
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly CHORRILEUM EIDOLON unit that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: That unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, that unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn. The unit using this ability cannot use any other RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Serve the Enclave
entries.effect: While this unit and a friendly CHORRILEUM NAMARTI unit are contesting the same objective, this unit has a control score of 10 that cannot be modified.

entries.name: Ammonite Carnyx
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CHORRILEUM NAMARTI unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
entries.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Essence of the Chorrileum
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CHORRILEUM WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CHORRILEUM unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: If the target is NAMARTI, you can return D6 slain models to it. Otherwise, Heal (D3) the target.

entries.name: Slipstream
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CHORRILEUM WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CHORRILEUM unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

entries.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Incarnate of the Deep endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly CHORRILEUM WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up an Incarnate of the Deep wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
